title: Free Produce Market
description: Grab your reusable bag and stock up on free organic produce at Sprouts’ bi-weekly market!

title: Vegan Club Meeting
description: Everyone is welcome to come and join us, whether you're vegan or veg-curious, or just want to meet new people! You don't need to be a member or be vegan.

title: AMS: Rally for Skytrain to UBC
description: Enjoy a free BBQ with live music while rallying support to push for funding and approval of the SkyTrain extension to UBC.

title: Meal Planning 101
description: Join us for meal planning tips that fit your busy schedule, budgets and dietary needs and make your own mason jar burrito bowl to take home!

title: CUS: All Candidates Forum
food: Bubble Tea, Dinner, and Gift Cards
description: Meet the First-Year Rep candidates, hear their platforms, enjoy dinner and bubble tea, and win prizes while getting ready to vote.

title: JA Lounge
description: Relax with free coffee, tea, snacks, and games while hanging out with friends in a cozy lounge setting.

title: UBC Quantum: Casino Night
description: Join us for an exciting evening of entangled entertainment and curious computation at our very own Quantum Casino Night!

title: UBC UX Hub: Get to know us
description: Enjoy free food, meet fellow UX enthusiasts, and kickstart your journey with alumni, mentors, and peers in a fun, social setting.

title: Speed Networking
location: Birmingham Room, Sauder School of Business
description: Meet potential case comp teammates, play games, and bond over free food while learning what it takes to compete and win.

title: WiCS x Atlassian: Women in Tech Panel
description: Join Atlassian as they launch into UBC 🚀 Enjoy a panel from Atlassian’s team followed by additional networking time to get to know the industry professionals. Get excited to learn about Atlassian (+ their career opportunities 👀), eat snacks, and connect with like-minded students!

title: Undergraduate Research Awards Workshop
description: Learn about paid research opportunities, hear tips from past award recipients, and get your questions answered over free food and snacks.

title: SUS: Coffee Chats
description: Chat with grad/undergrad students and peers about their research journeys, ask questions in a casual setting, and enjoy free food and drinks.

title: Mingle & Mould With MEDGEN
description: Play bingo and win prizes, mold proteins with clay, meet new friends through icebreakers, and enjoy free pizza while learning about the club.

title: Atelier: UBC #102
description: Calling all artists, engineers, writers, programmers, and makers of every kind—explore your curiosity, build passion projects, and share your creations with a supportive community.

title: Shift Leader Social
description: Make clay crafts, enjoy desserts, and connect with shift leaders and execs in a fun, casual hangout.

title: SISA: Friends Giving
description: Enjoy a free night of dinner, desserts, games, and a photo booth while hanging out with friends and community.

title: Clothing Drive & Swap
description: Refresh your wardrobe & give back! 👕✨

title: BIPOC Coffee Hour
description: Connect with fellow BIPOC students in a welcoming space and enjoy light refreshments together.

title: In Tune With Your Brain: The Power of Music
description: Discover how music shapes the brain through inspiring talks, live performances, and interactive discussions that blend science, wellness, and creativity.

title: Imprint Launch Event
location: Bruce R. Birmingham Undergraduate Centre and CPA Hall
description: Curious about marketing?  Want to get your name out there through our case competition? Join us for a fun evening of workshops, networking, and FREE FOOD! 😋

title: Employer On-Campus: Kiewit
description: Meet Kiewit reps, explore their big engineering and construction projects, and learn about career opportunities—all with free pizza.

title: Linguaphobia, Linguistic Indifference, and the Monolingual University
description: Join thought-provoking talks and discussions on language barriers, linguistic justice, and the dominance of English at universities—all with catered food to enjoy.
